name: Loan Prequalification Calculator
meta_title: Loan Prequalification Calculator: How Much Can I Borrow?
meta_description: Estimate the largest loan you could prequalify for from your income, current debts, interest rate, term and a lender's debt-to-income limit.
subtitle: Estimate the most you could borrow on a personal, auto or other installment loan, based on your income, your existing debt payments and the debt-to-income limit a lender applies. You can also check whether a specific loan amount fits.
